Antiquities 18.63-64 contains confessional Christian phrasing that most modern scholarship regards as at least partly a later insertion, with Eusebius in the fourth century the earliest secure witness to the received wording. Antiquities 20.200 is more widely accepted as authentic, though not universally. Flagged as disputed, resolved in neither direction. Date orders the segment.
